identificationModule.briefTitle: An Open Label, Safety and Tolerability Continuation Study of Intracerebroventricular Administration of sNN0029 to Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open Label, Safety and Tolerability Continuation Study of Intracerebroventricular Administration of sNN0029 to Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, Using an Implanted Catheter and SynchroMed® II Pump

statusModule.whyStopped: Issues with development and supply of infusion system for delivery of IMP. Lack of favorable benefit risk ratio in sNN0029-003 study (review of interim data).

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open label safety and tolerability continuation study of intracerebroventricular administration of sNN0029, containing the growth factor VEGF165, in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that have previously participated in study sNN0029-001. The intention of the study is to investigate safety and tolerability of intracerebroventricular administration of sNN0029 and whether it can improve motor function and prolong survival in patients with ALS.

statusModule.whyStopped: Issues with development and supply of infusion system for delivery of IMP. Lack of favorable benefit risk ratio in sNN0029-003 study (review of interim data).

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase I, multicentre randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial to assess the safety and tolerability of continuous i.c.v. administration of sNN0029 infusion solution at a dose of 4µg/day in patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS).

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, follow-on phase 1 study to assess the long-term safety and tolerability of continuous i.c.v administration of 4 μg sNN0029/day in patients with ALS who previously participated in study sNN0029-003

identificationModule.briefTitle: A Safety and Tolerability Study of Intracerebroventricular Administration of sNN0029 to Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-blind, Randomised, Parallel Group Safety and Tolerability Study of Intracerebroventricular Administration of sNN0029 to Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, Using an Implanted Catheter and SynchroMed® II Pump

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is conducted to evaluate the safety and tolerability of the drug product sNN0029, containing the growth factor VEGF165, when administered directly into one of the fluid filled cavities in the brain using an implanted catheter and an implanted SynchroMed® II pump. Patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis will be enrolled.

interventions.name: sNN0029
interventions.description: Continuous ICV infusion at one of three dose levels
